about_the_game:
This is a short, slightly terrifying, suspenseful and bizarre visual novel game. Players will take on the role of student Mo Lan, who loses all memories and joins a school of social monsters to rescue bullied classmates and uncover the truth behind campus bullying.

——————Dividing line——————

The moment I opened my eyes, I found myself in the dark water tank, and the cold water poured in ruthlessly, compressing the remaining breathing space. I struggled to breathe, trying to find a way to survive, but to no avail. 

 "No... Help me..." 

 Memory drifts with the waves and falls into the deep water after endless confusion and wandering. 

 I, Mo Lan, a freshman of Li World College. He was betrayed by his classmates when completing the entrance examination. If he failed the exam, he was sentenced to death and suffocated in the cold water. 

 I remembered a lot of forgotten memories - the girl pretending to be strong in the confinement room, his farewell under the starry sky in the woods, and the affectionate embrace in the sea of fire... And many memory fragments from the past. 

 Finally, I came to a vast space and met the mysterious reincarnation. He told me that he had been trapped in a school called Li World College with other students and was forced to become their students. 

 We have been tortured in the school, but we can't escape. If we want to escape, we have to graduate from this school. 

 The college is cursed by the cycle of time. After each death, I will return to the day of the entrance ceremony, when I will forget all the memories of the past and return to the starting point of time with a new identity and enter the school again. 

 "It turns out... Everything is just a cycle. 

 Aware of the dark truth hidden behind the scenes of the campus, I finally decided to restart the reincarnation, find a way to break the curse of the time cycle, and unravel the cruel truth to save the bullied classmates. 

 "I will definitely find a way to escape from this horrible hell... At that time, I will find my lost memory, come back here again, and ask you to make it clear!" 

 I lost my memory again and returned to the desperate and cold classroom. 

 ——————Division line—————— 

 1. In the dark and gloomy horror college, teachers who are monsters will regularly release impossible exam tasks, and students who fail the exam will be brutally executed. 

 2. Campus bullying? Power trading? The college is full of dark deals that can't be seen. 

 3. Friendship? Love? The four characters will work with you to survive in a tense and exciting life. 

 You will enter the game with your body, completely destroy all the darkness, and the real light will be ushered in by you. 

 QQ communication group number: 1011418351 

 ——————Division line—————— 

 According to the United Nations report, 246 million children worldwide are bullied in schools every year. 

 When you encounter bullying, please raise your fist and resist boldly. Only resistance can end the atrocities! 

 May the world be peaceful and there will be no more tears.

content_descriptors.notes: Horror pictures and images can be blocked in the game settings.
